summary: Third testing run completed. Two new features tested: 1) Receipt/invoice attachment for expenses (receipt_base64 field + image picker UI), 2) Push notification reminders CRUD system. Backend: 9/9 tests passed. Frontend: All new features verified working via UI testing. Existing features (dashboard, properties, income, reports) continue to work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Receipt Feature: ExpenseCreate and ExpenseOut models correctly include receipt_base64: Optional[str] field
Receipt Storage: Base64 data URIs stored in MongoDB (format: data:image/jpeg;base64,...)
Receipt UI: expo-image-picker integrated with Gallery and Camera buttons on Add Expense screen
Receipt Display: Receipt badge and thumbnail display correctly in expenses list on property detail screen
Reminders Backend: ReminderCreate and ReminderOut models with all required fields (property_id, title, category, amount, due_day, frequency, notes, active)
Reminders CRUD: All endpoints working - POST /api/reminders, GET /api/reminders, PUT /api/reminders/{id}/toggle, DELETE /api/reminders/{id}
Reminders Property Names: GET /api/reminders correctly enriches response with property_name field by joining with properties collection
Reminders UI: Settings > Bill Reminders navigation working, reminders screen with add form and list functional
Reminders Form: All fields present - property selector, title, amount, due day, frequency (monthly/quarterly/yearly), category
Reminders Toggle: Active/inactive toggle switch working correctly
All existing features continue to work: Dashboard, Properties CRUD, Income/Expense, Reports, Settings
Push Notifications: Stored in DB, actual push requires native build (MOCKED as documented)
seed_data_creation: Test property prop_c0e2f1669631 (Test Image Property) has expense exp_4643a6b22253 with receipt. Reminder rem_67e78ae8a3b0 exists (Monthly Mortgage Payment, $2,500, due 15th).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features fully functional: 1) Receipt/invoice attachment for expenses - backend accepts receipt_base64 field, frontend shows image picker with Gallery/Camera buttons, receipts display as badge and thumbnail in expense list. 2) Bill Reminders CRUD - backend has full CRUD endpoints with property name enrichment, frontend has Settings > Bill Reminders navigation, reminders screen with add form (property selector, title, amount, due day, frequency, category), list view with toggle switches, and delete functionality. All existing features (Dashboard, Properties, Income, Expense, Reports) continue to work correctly. Push notifications are mocked (stored in DB, actual push requires native build).
